latin: Ad probandum primam materiam esse, magis certificat uel uia numerorum, uel uia catholicae philosophiae, quam ulla ratio physica in qua sensus habeat introitum.
translation: Either the way of numbers or the way of universal philosophy gives a surer proof that prime matter exists than any physical argument in which the senses play a part.
translation_note: 'uia catholicae philosophiae' = the 'universal' philosophy, i.e. reasoning from cosmic correspondences, not a confessional sense; sense checked.
